canonical_title: Google and Marvell expand custom AI chip partnership with up to $12.2B equity warrant
treatment: Covered as a new strategic custom-AI-chip partnership. Reinclude only for material purchase commitments, warrant exercise, disclosed chip generations/specifications, production deployments, or a material change in Google's Broadcom/Marvell supplier mix.
known_facts: Reuters reported on August 19, 2026 that Marvell will help develop a broad range of chips and related technologies designed to work with Google's TPU ecosystem.
Google received a warrant to buy up to 58.97 million Marvell shares at $206.58 per share, worth about $12.18 billion if fully exercised according to Reuters calculations.
Most of the warrant becomes exercisable only if Google meets agreed purchasing targets through fiscal 2033, tying Google's potential equity stake to future procurement from Marvell.
Broadcom remains Google's major custom-chip partner and has a separate long-term agreement covering future custom AI chips and next-generation AI rack components through 2031.
reinclude_only_if: Google or Marvell discloses specific chip products, specifications, tape-out, production or deployment milestones under the partnership.
Google meets material purchase thresholds, exercises a material portion of the warrant, or Marvell discloses quantified revenue or order commitments tied to Google.
Google materially changes its Broadcom relationship or supplier allocation for TPU/custom AI chip development.
A new generation of Google TPU or related AI rack technology is officially announced as part of the Marvell partnership.
notes: Reuters published the report at 2026-08-19 12:38 UTC = 21:38 JST, inside the 2026-08-19 Night Lite window.
